lines: Chaand bhi dekha, phool bhi dekha
couplets.en: I have seen the moon and the flower.

lines: Baadal, bijli, titli, jugnu
couplets.en: I have seen clouds, lightning, butterflies and fireflies.

lines: Koi nahin hai aisa
couplets.en: None can compare.

lines: Tera husn hai jaisa
couplets.en: Your beauty has no likeness.

lines: Meri nigaah ne yeh kaisa khwaab dekha hai
couplets.en: What dream have my eyes seen?

lines: Zameen pe jalta hua mahtaab dekha hai
couplets.en: I saw the moon burning here on earth.

lines: Meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
couplets.en: My eyes chose you after seeing the world.

lines: Kiska chehra ab main dekhoon tera chehra dekh kar
couplets.en: Whose face could I look upon now that I have seen yours?

lines: Neend bhi dekhi, khwaab bhi dekha
